    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.card_le_degree_of_common_stable_witness (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [IsGalois k F] {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (P : I → TwoTerm R) (B : I → FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)) (S : FGModuleCat R) (hs : ∀ (i : I), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k (P i)).IsStable S) (hb : ∀ (i : I), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R (P i))).IsStable (B i)) (hm : ∀ (i : I), ∃ (f : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R (B i)), f ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ B)) :
    Fintype.card I ≤ Module.finrank k F

    Pairwise distinct stable extension modules which descend to the same ground stable witness have cardinality at most the extension degree. Each module may use a different projective weight.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_ground_witness_finset_galois (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [IsGalois k F] {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (P : I → TwoTerm R) (B : I → FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)) (d : ℕ) (hB : Function.Injective (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ B)) (hs : ∀ (i : I), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R (P i))).IsStable (B i)) (hd : ∀ (i : I), Module.finrank F ↑(B i).obj ≤ d) :
    ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))), Fintype.card I ≤ Module.finrank k F * s.card ∧ ∀ c ∈ s, ∃ (M : FGModuleCat R) (i : I), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton M = c ∧ (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k (P i)).IsStable M ∧ Module.finrank k ↑M.obj ≤ Module.finrank k F * d ∧ endolength k M ≤ d

    Restricting a finite family of distinct stable extension modules costs at most the extension degree in cardinality, independently of the weights.
